offers_products.reason: Designs and sells apparel and footwear: Tommy Bahama, Lilly Pulitzer, Johnny Was, Southern Tide, Jack Rogers.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is from branded apparel; Tommy Bahama restaurants and hotel are small hospitality add-ons, not main offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells through own stores, e-commerce and restaurants directly to shoppers buying women's, men's and children's apparel.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Wholesale channel sells to department stores, specialty retailers and off-price retailers who resell the brands.

recurring_revenue.reason: Loyal customers repeatedly buy seasonal apparel; brands emphasize return customers, though no contracts or subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Premium discretionary apparel and resort wear can be easily postponed or cut in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Typical purchase is a shirt, dress or sandals: small, frequent apparel purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for branded apparel goods and brand design, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are households shopping direct; wholesale to retailers is a smaller part.

asset_heavy.reason: Outsources apparel production; owns brands, a distribution center and leased stores, so it is not heavy-asset.

notes: Channel mix (direct-to-consumer vs wholesale) comes from general knowledge; the website text doesn't give it.
